verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The three flavour names are stacked in a centred column, and their descriptors are listed separately in a different order, so no flavour matches its descriptor. There is one oversized can and two thumbnail cans, the CTA is a tiny pill whose label can't be read, and the delivery line is crammed into the middle of the text stack. A is marginally less bad because its big can on the left roughly balances the CTA; B's big can is jammed against the right edge and its CTA floats under the text with no anchor.
